name: Open Context
description:
Open Context lets you store, organize, and reuse context across your Al workflows. You can save profiles, documents, instructions, and other structured information In one place, then load exactly what you need into a conversation or tool when you need It.

Instead of re-explaining background or copying the same prompts, you work from a shared, persistent source of truth. This helps keep conversations consistent, makes personalization easy, and enables workflows that rely on long-lived knowledge and memory.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Open Context to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Open Context to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.opnctx.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Open Context MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Context lists 21 MCP tools, including create_profile, delete_library_item, get_last_stash, get_library_item, get_media_item, get_profile, get_relevant_context, get_space, get_space_items, get_space_vocabulary, get_taxonomy, and list_library_items.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Open Context?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Open Context in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Open Context MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Context requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Open Context is developed by FOUND Studios LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
